current_state.label: reflective
current_state.notes: Example state label only; no claim that this state is a separate identity or more truthful state.

context_claims.text: The person was taught a default sequence of school, university, employment and stability.
The person currently wants to decide whether university remains useful for reasons they endorse now.

root_algorithm_candidates.description: A socially inherited education-to-employment sequence may have shaped expectations before conscious authorship.
evidence_needed: relevant historical evidence if the human wants to provide it

candidate_families.hypothesis: The current education desire primarily continues an inherited default sequence.
candidate_families.difference: Explains the desire mainly through inherited conditioning.

candidate_families.hypothesis: The person understands the inherited sequence and independently re-endorses education as useful now.
candidate_families.difference: Explains the same action as reflective re-endorsement rather than automatic continuation.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Another explanation remains possible because the available context is incomplete.
candidate_families.difference: Preserves incompleteness rather than forcing the available stories to be exhaustive.

unknowns: The relative weight of conditioning and current endorsement is not established by this example.

human_consent.question: Now that I can see what shaped this desire, do I still consent to carrying it?
human_consent.notes: The protocol must not infer an answer.
